Limited palette: kraft brown, cream, dusty blue, mustard yellow, warm gray. One accent red (#D92F2B) only on Tetsu's boxing hand wraps; nothing else in the picture is red.
No black outlines: shapes are separated by paper edges and shadows. Faces are simple cut-paper shapes with a few ink details.
Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Everything important stays inside the central 16:9 band (about 8% empty margin top and bottom).
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, circles, motion lines, impact stars or any effects.
No blood, wounds, bruises, broken teeth or weapons. Original characters, not resembling any real person or existing cartoon.

Tetsu, original male boxer, 24, lean wiry athletic build, tan skin, short black undercut hair, sharp focused eyes, thin scar across the left eyebrow, shirtless, mustard-yellow knee-length fight shorts, barefoot, bright red (#D92F2B) boxing hand wraps on both hands.
Character design sheet: the same character shown three times side by side on a plain cream paper background, front view, side view, back view, standing relaxed, full body.
Use the attached gray reference sheet only for this character's face, hair, scar, body proportions and clothes. Redraw the character in the paper-collage style described above.

Sheet-specific composition clarification: render ONLY the three full-body standing views on an uninterrupted plain cream paper background. No wall, ring, ropes, disc, floor, scenery, labels or scene props on this character sheet. Keep the same scale and identity in all three views, arranged left front / center true side / right back. Keep the entire head and feet of every view between y=100 and y=924, with ample space between figures. Physically layered cut-paper pieces with visible subtle fibre rims and soft cast shadows; simplified flat paper muscle shapes rather than painted or smoothly rendered anatomy. The colored clothing in the written description overrides the grayscale colors of the reference. Any healed eyebrow scar is a thin neutral paper/ink detail, never red. Exactly 1536x1024 pixels.

EDIT INSTRUCTIONS — Image 1 is the already approved paper-collage candidate to edit; image 2 is the old grayscale identity reference only. Correct the framing of image 1: make ALL THREE entire paper figures smaller by a uniform factor of 0.86 about the canvas center. Preserve their relative positions and original proportions, every face, clothing color, torn paper edges, layer shadows and all design details. Keep the canvas exactly 1536x1024. Fill newly empty space with the same plain cream textured paper. All hair/head tops must be BELOW y=135, and all feet/shoes must be ABOVE y=910. There must be at least 110 pixels of uninterrupted empty cream paper at BOTH the top and the bottom; absolutely no part of any character or its cast shadow in those two margins. Do NOT just zoom or crop; reduce the entire figures so the complete full bodies are comfortably inside the safe band. No text or guides.
